projectOfTheMonth.title: Hand Gesture-Based Volume Control System
projectOfTheMonth.description: This project enables users to control their system volume using just hand gestures detected through a webcam. By measuring the distance between the thumb and index finger using MediaPipe's hand landmarks, the system adjusts the volume in real-time.

projectOfTheMonth.title: ByteCode - Online Code Compiler
projectOfTheMonth.description: A  full-stack online code compiler that supports Python, C++, and Java, enabling users to write, compile, and execute code directly from their browsers.

recentProjects.title: iStream
recentProjects.description: iStream is a production-grade live-streaming platform built from primitives without managed streaming services. It supports RTMP ingest, adaptive-bitrate FFmpeg streaming, HLS delivery, Cloudflare R2-based VOD storage, real-time chat, payments, notifications, and an autoscaling transcoding worker pool.

recentProjects.title: kitcat
recentProjects.description: A Git-compatible version control system built from scratch in Go. kitcat implements Git's core object model — content-addressed storage, a binary index, zlib-compressed objects, and a full porcelain command set — using the same on-disk format as Git itself.

recentProjects.title: Vybe - Your Digital Social Circle
recentProjects.description: Vybe is a Firebase-powered social media platform built with React and Chakra UI that enables users to connect, create, and collaborate through community circles called VybeCircles. It provides real-time messaging, social interactions, user profiles, notifications, trending content, and interest-based communities.

recentProjects.title: Veren
recentProjects.description: Veren is a backend-driven deployment system that automates building and deploying applications from source repositories using a service-oriented architecture.
